newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-Equity Residential FFO upped.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Equity Residential FFO upped.

text.p: --EVEREN Securities said Thursday it raised its funds from operations estimates for 1997 to $3.55 from $3.52 and for 1998 to $3.85 from $3.80, reflecting the earnings boost expected from the company's pending acquisition of Wellsford Residential Properties Trust.
--EVEREN said, however, it slightly lowered its 1996 FFO estimate to $3.12 from $3.13 because of modest dilution from the company's December equity offerings.
--The price targets for Equity Residential, EVEREN said, remain at $45.50 for six months and $47.50 for 18 months.
--Equity Residential, a real estate investment trust, traded off 1/8 at 41-3/4.
